_method: Web search only. No venue was visited, phoned, or photographed. Every entry below was reached from a search-result page; see `source` on each one for what was actually read and `confidence` for what that does and does not establish.
_source_vs_lead: Per CLAUDE.md's data rules and the brief for this session: a venue's own Facebook page or its Google Maps listing is a SOURCE. A listicle, a travel blog, a review aggregator (Tripadvisor, Wanderlog, Trip.com, Evendo, kupi, petitfute, coool.cafe) or a taxi-company blog is a LEAD — it means someone says the place exists, not that anything about it is confirmed. Every entry records which it is.
_hours: Every `hours` below is null, and that is a finding rather than a gap. Facebook renders its page content behind a login/JS wall, so a fetch of a venue's own page returns the name and the city and nothing else — no address, no hours, no phone (verified on facebook.com/damdamcoffee, which returned exactly that). Google Maps listings are not fetchable the same way. Aggregator sites DO print hours, but an aggregator is a lead, and copying hours out of one is exactly the thing CLAUDE.md forbids. So: nobody should fill `hours` from this file. Hours come from opening the venue's own page, or from being there.
_popularity: There is no footfall or popularity data for Laos and none was used to order this list. Google's popular-times is not exposed in any Google API and is only available by scraping the Maps page, which is both against their terms and unreliable. There is no Lao equivalent of Yelp. The review counts on Tripadvisor/Wanderlog for Vientiane venues are in the low tens and are dominated by visitors rather than residents, so they measure tourist traffic, not whether a place is busy on a Tuesday. Anything that turns up claiming to be Lao footfall data should be treated as a lead and its provenance written down before it is used. Nothing in the app should be ordered by it.
_duplicates_checked: Cross-checked against all 30 ids in data/venues.json on 2026-09-13. Common Grounds, Tipsy Elephant, Wind West and Corebeer already exist and are excluded. `sinouk-pavilion-km9` is included deliberately: data/venues.json already has `sinouk-khemkhong`, but this is a different address (KM9 Thadeua Rd vs Quai Fa Ngum) and so is a different venue, not a duplicate — confirm before adding either way.
_next_step: For each candidate: open the `source` URL, read the venue's own page, and write down the address, the hours and the phone AS THE PAGE STATES THEM. Then decide whether it belongs in the app at all — that is an editorial call, not a completeness exercise.
